claims.text: A 35-year-old woman, gravida 4 para 3 with three previous cesarean deliveries, presented asymptomatic at 6 weeks and 5 days of gestation. Ultrasound showed a gestational sac implanted at the site of the previous cesarean scar, consistent with cesarean scar pregnancy. She was counseled, offered termination, expressed a desire to preserve fertility, opted against termination and was placed under close follow-up.
